criteria.openLatency_note: openMsClean is the mutation-precise click->first-DOM-change figure; openMs is rAF-quantised (~16.7ms) and is reported only as a sanity cross-check.
criteria.amplification_note: ABSOLUTE sustained cost per second vs the same-page closed-settings baseline. Only meaningful while ambient event load is comparable; prefer perEventAmplification when load differs.
criteria.per_event_note: LOAD-NORMALISED amplification: ms of Script per ambient session event, tab vs closed-settings baseline on the same page. Primary "does this tab itself cost more" test, because the host is shared with a live streaming session and absolute cost tracks that stream.
criteria.frame_rate_note: closed-settings baseline ran at ~57 fps on this (already loaded) host; a sustained window below 45 fps means rAF could not keep up, which is the clearest user-perceivable symptom.
criteria.jank_note: frames longer than 50ms per 100 frames, versus the same figure measured with settings closed.

thisBatch.directObservation: During this batch `ps` was used live and recorded >=3 concurrent headless Chromium instances on this host; tab-profile also leaked its own crashed-run browser from 15:04 until 15:28. Both are recorded in audit.md section 3.
thisBatch.caveat: LOWER BOUND ONLY: processes that started and exited during the batch are invisible to /proc after the fact, so a lower bound of 0 does NOT prove exclusivity.
thisBatch.status: NOT EXCLUSIVE (refuted by direct observation during the batch; retrospectively invisible)

concurrency.headline: No tab-profile batch was exclusive, including the one whose lock tab-profile actually held. Per the standing order no further browser was launched to retry: exclusivity was empirically unobtainable (the coordinator measured 0/5 exclusive windows and 18-31 foreign Playwright processes per window during another line's 1635s lock hold).
concurrency.pollutionTierReason: Per-window concurrent-browser counts were NOT recorded live for this batch (the instrumentation was added afterwards). Retroactive process-start analysis refutes exclusivity for both batches. Therefore no window in this batch may be used for a load-sensitive verdict; only structural/count conclusions survive.

runMeta.cdpNote: Performance.getMetrics returns cumulative counters; raw snapshots are recorded per window and all deltas are computed by this script.
runMeta.wsNote: WS frames classified by payload discriminator (MuxFrame/HostFrame type) and one level deeper for session/event - never by envelope type.
runMeta.usageNote: /usage/<method> is a real HTTP POST surface on the host origin (verified by recon), not an /api RPC path.
runMeta.confounderNote: The host is shared with a concurrently running agent session; ambient session/event traffic is measured as the closed-settings baseline and cannot be paused by this read-only probe.

map+profile.note: 16 profile runs (8 tabs x 2 repeats) completed PASS; the plugins phase of that same process then hit a harness bug (missing mm.snap in the poll loop) and wrote nothing.

plugins.note: re-run solo after adding CDP network-stack timing for /usage/*; Playwright request.timing() returned -1 for these requests so wallMs was null in the first pass.
